en.hubeali: H 14509 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sa’d Bin Abu Khalaf, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws has said that
the dreams are of three aspects - Good News from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for the Believer, and a caution against the Satan<sup>la</sup>, and confused dreams’.
en.sarwar: 61. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sa’d Bin Abu Khalaf, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said that
the dreams are of three aspects - Good News from Allah (azwj) for the Believer, and a caution against the Satan (la), and confused dreams’.
